verses.geez: ለዓለቅት፡ ሠላስ፡ አዋልድ፡ ላቲ፡ ተፋቅሮ፡ እለ፡ ይትፋቀራ፡ ወሠለስቲሆን፡ እለ፡ ኢይጸግባ፡ ወራብዕቶንሰ፡ ስእንት፡ ብሂለ፡ ኮንየ።
verses.translation: As dew in harvest, and as rain in summer, so honour is not seemly for a fool.

translations.lxx: As dew in harvest, and as rain in summer, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
translations.kjv: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
translations.ron: Precum este zăpada în timpul verii şi ploaia la seceriş, aşa nu-i place celui nebun cinstea.

verses.geez: ሲኦል፡ ወፍቅረ፡ ብእሲት፡ ወገሃነም፡ ምድር፡ እንተ፡ ኢተመልእ፡ ማየ፡ ወማይ፡ ወእሳት፡ ኢይብል፡ ኮንየ።
verses.translation: As birds and sparrows fly, so a curse shall not come upon any one without a cause.

translations.lxx: As birds and sparrows fly, so a curse shall not come upon any one without a cause.
translations.kjv: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
translations.ron: Precum vrabia zboară şi rândunica se înalţă în văzduh, tot aşa blestemul fără pricină nu nimereşte.

verses.geez: ዓይን፡ ዘይስሕቅ፡ አባሁወዘያስተአኪ፡ ርስዓ፡ እሙ፡ ይመልሕዎ፡ ቋዓት፡ እምግቡ፡ ወይበልዕዎን፡ እጒለ፡ አንስርት፡ ለአዕይንቲሁ።
verses.translation: As a whip for a horse, and a goad for an ass, so is a rod for a simple nation.

translations.lxx: As a whip for a horse, and a goad for an ass, so is a rod for a simple nation.
translations.kjv: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.
translations.ron: Biciul este bun pentru cal, frâul pentru măgar, iar varga pentru spatele celor nebuni.

verses.geez: ሠለስቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ዘኢይክል፡ አእምሮሙ፡ ወራብዖሙሰ፡ ኢይጤየቅ።
verses.translation: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou become like him.

translations.lxx: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou become like him.
translations.kjv: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.
translations.ron: Nu răspunde nebunului după nebunia lui, ca să nu te asemeni şi tu cu el.

verses.geez: አሠረ፡ ነስር፡ ዘይሠርር፡ ወፍኖተ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ዲበ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ ወአሠረ፡ ሐመር፡ ዲበ፡ ሞገድ፡ እንዘ፡ ተሐውር፡ ወፍናወ፡ ብእሲ፡ በውርዙቱ።
verses.translation: Yet answer a fool according to his folly, lest he seem wise in his own conceit.

translations.lxx: Yet answer a fool according to his folly, lest he seem wise in his own conceit.
translations.kjv: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
translations.ron: Răspunde nebunului după nebunia lui, ca să nu se creadă înţelept în ochii lui.

verses.geez: ወከመዝ፡ ውእቱ፡ ፍኖታ፡ ለብእሲት፡ እንተ፡ መሐዝ፡ እንተ፡ ገቢራ፡ ትትሐጸብ፡ ወአልቦ፡ እንከሰ፡ ዘገብረት፡ እኩየ።
verses.translation: He that sends a message by a foolish messenger procures for himself a reproach from his own ways.

translations.lxx: He that sends a message by a foolish messenger procures for himself a reproach from his own ways.
translations.kjv: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.
translations.ron: Cel ce încredinţează solia în mâna celui nebun îşi taie picioarele şi bea nedreptate.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ነገር፡ ታድለቀልቅ፡ ምድር፡ ወራብዖሙሰ፡ ኢትክል፡ ፀዊረ።
verses.translation: As well take away the motion of the legs, as transgression from the mouth of fools.

translations.lxx: As well take away the motion of the legs, as transgression from the mouth of fools.
translations.kjv: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
translations.ron: Precum nu poate să se folosească slăbănogul de picioarele sale, tot aşa nici cei nebuni de cuvintele cele înţelepte.

verses.geez: ገብር፡ እመ፡ ነግሠ፡ ወዐብድ፡ ለእመ፡ ጸግበ፡ እክለ።
verses.translation: He that binds up a stone in a sling, is like one that gives glory to a fool.

translations.lxx: He that binds up a stone in a sling, is like one that gives glory to a fool.
translations.kjv: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.
translations.ron: Ca şi când pui o piatră în praştie, aşa este cel ce dă cinste unui nebun.

verses.geez: ወአመት፡ እመ፡ አውፅአት፡ እግዝእታ፡ ወጽእልት፡ ብእእሲት፡ እመ፡ አድምዐት፡ ብእሴ፡ ኄረ።
verses.translation: Thorns grow in the hand of a drunkard, and servitude in the hand of fools.

translations.lxx: Thorns grow in the hand of a drunkard, and servitude in the hand of fools.
translations.kjv: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
translations.ron: Precum un ghimpe intră în mâna unui beţiv, tot aşa sunt cuvintele înţelepte în gura celor păcătoşi.

verses.geez: ወአርባዕቱ፡ ሕፁፃን፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ወእሉ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ጠቢባነ፡ ጠበብት።
verses.translation: All the flesh of fools endures much hardship; for their fury is brought to nought.

translations.lxx: All the flesh of fools endures much hardship; for their fury is brought to nought.
translations.kjv: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
translations.ron: Ca un arcaş care răneşte pe toţi, aşa este cel ce se pune chezaş pentru cel nebun şi pentru cei ce trec pe cale.

verses.geez: ሰኳዕት፡ እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ኃይል፡ ወያስተዳልዉ፡ በማእረር፡ ሲሳዮሙ።
verses.translation: As when a dog goes to his own vomit, and becomes abominable, so is a fool who returns in his wickedness to his own sin.

translations.lxx: [There is a shame that brings sin: and there is a shame that is glory and grace.]
translations.kjv: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.
translations.ron: Ca un câine care se întoarce unde a vărsat, aşa este omul nebun care se întoarce la nebunia lui.

verses.geez: ወግሔያት፡ ሕዝብ፡ ዘኢኮኑ፡ ፅኑዓነ፡ እለ፡ ረሰዩ፡ ውስተ፡ ግበበ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ አብያቲሆሙ።
verses.translation: I have seen a man who seemed to himself to be wise; but a fool had more hope than he.

translations.lxx: I have seen a man who seemed to himself to be wise; but a fool had more hope than he.
translations.kjv: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
translations.ron: Dacă vezi un om care se crede înţelept în ochii lui, să nădăjduieşti mai mult de la un nebun decât de la el.

verses.geez: ወዘእንበለ፡ መንግሥት፡ ውእቱ፡ አንበጣ፡ ዘየሐውር፡ በአሐዱ፡ ትእዛዝ፡ ኅቡረ።
verses.translation: A sluggard when sent on a journey says, There is a lion in the ways, and there are murderers in the streets.

translations.lxx: A sluggard when sent on a journey says, There is a lion in the ways, and there are murderers in the streets.
translations.kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
translations.ron: Leneşul zice: "Pe drum trece un leu, un leu pe uliţe!"

verses.geez: ወላጽቂት፡ ዘበእደዊሁ፡ የሐውር፡ እንዘ፡ ጽቡስ፡ ውእቱ፡ የኀድር፡ ውስተ፡ አብያተ፡ ነገሥት።
verses.translation: As a door turns on the hinge, so does a sluggard on his bed.

translations.lxx: As a door turns on the hinge, so does a sluggard on his bed.
translations.kjv: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.
translations.ron: Precum uşa se suceşte în ţâţână, tot aşa şi leneşul în patul lui.

verses.geez: ሠለስቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ዘአዳመ፡ የሐውሩ፡ ወራብዕሰ፡ ዘሠናይ፡ ፍናዊሁ።
verses.translation: A sluggard having hid his hand in his bosom, will not be able to bring it up to his mouth.

translations.lxx: A sluggard having hid his hand in his bosom, will not be able to bring it up to his mouth.
translations.kjv: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.
translations.ron: Leneşul bagă mâna în blid, dar cu mare greutate o duce la gură.

verses.geez: እጓለ፡ አንበሳ፡ ዘይፀንዕ፡ እምእንስሳ፡ ኢይትመየጥ፡ ወኢደነግፅ፡ እምእንስሳ።
verses.translation: A sluggard seems to himself wiser than one who most satisfactorily brings back a message.

translations.lxx: A sluggard seems to himself wiser than one who most satisfactorily brings back a message.
translations.kjv: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
translations.ron: Leneşul se crede înţelept în ochii lui, mai mult decât şapte sfetnici înţelepţi.

verses.geez: ዶርሆ፡ ተባዕት፡ ዘየሐውር፡ ኀበ፡ አንስት፡ እንዘ፡ ያስተናፍስ፡ ከነፊሁ፡ ወበሐኵ፡ እንዘ፡ ይሜብል፡ ላዕለ፡ መርዔት፡ ወንጉሥ፡ እንዘ፡ ይጌሥፅ፡ ሕዝቦ።
verses.translation: As he that lays hold of a dog's tail, so is he that makes himself the champion of another's cause.

translations.lxx: As he that lays hold of a dog's tail, so is he that makes himself the champion of another's cause.
translations.kjv: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.
translations.ron: Ca cel ce prinde un câine de urechi, aşa este cel ce se vâră într-o ceartă în care nu este amestecat.

verses.geez: ለእመ፡ መጠውከ፡ ርእሰከ፡ ለተፈርንሶ፡ ወሰፋሕከ፡ እዴከ፡ ለጋእዝ፡ ተኀሥር።
verses.translation: As those who need correction put forth fair words to men, and he that first falls in with the proposal will be overthrown;

translations.lxx: As those who need correction put forth fair words to men, and he that first falls in with the proposal will be overthrown;
translations.kjv: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,
translations.ron: Ca unul care aruncă săgeţi arzătoare, lănci, săgeţi şi moarte,

verses.geez: ሕልብ፡ ሐሊበ፡ ወይከውነከ፡ ለስደ፡ ወለእመ፡ አጸርከ፡ አንፈከ፡ ይወጽእ፡ ደም፡ ወለእመ፡ ሰሐብከ፡ ነገረ፡ ይመጽእ፡ ጋእዝ፡ ወኵነኔ።
verses.translation: so are all that lay wait for their own friends, and when they are discovered, say, I did it in jest.

translations.lxx: so are all that lay wait for their own friends, and when they are discovered, say, I did it in jest.
translations.kjv: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?
translations.ron: Aşa e omul care înşală pe prietenul său şi zice: "Da, am glumit!"

verses.geez: ቃለ፡ ዚአየ፡ ተየድአ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ንጉሥ፡ ፌማ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘመሀረቶ፡ እሙ።
verses.translation: With much wood fire increases; but where there is not a double-minded man, strife ceases.

translations.lxx: With much wood fire increases; but where there is not a double-minded man, strife ceases.
translations.kjv: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
translations.ron: Când nu mai sunt lemne se stinge focul şi dacă nu mai este nici un defăimător se potoleşte cearta.

verses.geez: ኦ፡ ወልድየ፡ ተዐቀብ፡ ምንት፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: A hearth for coals, and wood for fire; and a railing man for the tumult of strife.

translations.lxx: A hearth for coals, and wood for fire; and a railing man for the tumult of strife.
translations.kjv: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.
translations.ron: Cărbunii slujesc pentru căldură, lemnele pentru foc, iar omul certăreţ pentru a aţâţa cearta.

verses.geez: ወኵርየ፡ ለከ፡ እብለከ፡ ወልድየ፡ ሚወልደ፡ ከርሥየ፡ ወሚ፡ ወልደ፡ ጸሎተ፡ ዚአየ።
verses.translation: The words of cunning knaves are soft; but they smite even to the inmost parts of the bowels.

translations.lxx: The words of cunning knaves are soft; but they smite even to the inmost parts of the bowels.
translations.kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
translations.ron: Vorbele celui defăimător sunt ca bucatele gustoase; ele se duc în adâncul măruntaielor.

verses.geez: ኢተሃባ፡ ለብእሲት፡ ብዕለ፡ ዚአከ፡ ወልበከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትነስሕ፡ ድኅረ፡ ወኢትግበር፡ ዘኢይደሉ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ወለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Silver dishonestly given is to be considered as a potsherd: smooth lips cover a grievous heart.

translations.lxx: Silver dishonestly given is to be considered as a potsherd: smooth lips cover a grievous heart.
translations.kjv: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
translations.ron: Spoială de argint care îmbracă un vas de lut, aşa sunt buzele mieroase şi o inimă rea.

verses.geez: ወኰንን፡ ኵሎ፡ ሰብአ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ወምስለ፡ ምክር፡ ኵሎ፡ ግበር፡ ወምስለ፡ ምክር፡ ወይነ፡ ስተይ።
verses.translation: A weeping enemy promises all things with his lips, but in his heart he contrives deceit.

translations.lxx: A weeping enemy promises all things with his lips, but in his heart he contrives deceit.
translations.kjv: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;
translations.ron: Cu buzele sale se preface cel ce urăşte, iar înlăuntrul lui nutreşte înşelăciune;

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ መኳንንት፡ መዓትማን፡ ወይነ፡ ኢይሰተዩ፡ ከመ፡ በስታይ፡ ኢይርስፅዋ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ወኢይክሉ፡ አርትዖ፡ ፍትሕ፡ ለድኩማን።
verses.translation: Though thine enemy intreat thee with a loud voice, consent not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.

translations.lxx: Though thine enemy intreat thee with a loud voice, consent not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.
translations.kjv: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.
translations.ron: Când îşi schimbă glasul, să nu-l crezi, căci şapte urâciuni sunt în inima lui.

verses.geez: ሀብዎሙ፡ ወይነ፡ ለኅዙናን፡ ወይስተዩ፡ ወይነ፡ ትኩዛን፡ ከመ፡ ይርስዕዋ፡ ለኀዘን፡ ወሕማመኒ፡ ኢይዝክሩ፡ እንከ።
verses.translation: He that hides enmity frames deceit: but being easily discerned, exposes his own sins in the public assemblies.

translations.lxx: He that hides enmity frames deceit: but being easily discerned, exposes his own sins in the public assemblies.
translations.kjv: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.
translations.ron: Cineva poate să-şi ascundă ura lui prin prefăcătorie, dar în adunare răutatea lui se dă pe faţă.

verses.geez: ክሥት፡ አፉከ፡ በቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወኰንን፡ ኵሎ፡ ሕያዋነ።
verses.translation: He that digs a pit for his neighbour shall fall into it: and he that rolls a stone, rolls it upon himself.

translations.lxx: He that digs a pit for his neighbour shall fall into it: and he that rolls a stone, rolls it upon himself.
translations.kjv: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
translations.ron: Cine sapă groapa (altuia) cade singur în ea şi cel ce rostogoleşte o piatră se prăvăleşte (tot) peste el.

verses.geez: ክሥት፡ አፉከ፡ ወኰንን፡ በጽድቅ፡ ፍታሕ፡ ለነዳይ፡ ወለሕሙም።
verses.translation: A lying tongue hates the truth; and an unguarded mouth causes tumults.

translations.lxx: A lying tongue hates the truth; and an unguarded mouth causes tumults.
translations.kjv: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
translations.ron: Limba mincinoasă urăşte adevărul şi gura linguşitorilor pricinuieşte prăbuşirea.
